name: Any frontend draws the session from plain data
principle: Any frontend can draw, steer and approve an AI session from plain data that names no harness and no terminal.
state_description: A page or app receives the run as JSON: every step, helper with its solution, the cost so far, the files changed, each message sent and whether it was taken up, the question that waits, and how it ended; a new kind of event shows as one generic row instead of breaking the page.
hints_of_measurement: Every event and control kind round-trips; each run fact is present; no terminal marker appears; an unknown event is kept apart.
